bio: Located on the edge of the Bergse Bos forest, with a romantic terrace and a pontoon on the River Rotte to the front, and a cosy, luxurious atmosphere inside, Nova is a really wonderful establishment! Your elegant hostess extends a warm welcome, and chef Vaandrager proposes an appealing menu. His contemporary dishes combine playful ideas with impressive culinary expertise. Whether preparing a salade niçoise with mi-cuit tuna or giving pink-roasted lamb a southern twist with a ratatouille garnish, he puts the focus firmly on bold flavours – and all at excellent value for money. Don't miss the chance to take a boat trip on the Rotte, perhaps with some snacks. You won't be disappointed!...
